messages:
Noah Kim: hey everyone, first day — finished Apple setup but I chose "set up later" for some options and now Kandji shows ‘deferred profile’ and Okta device trust fails during login. stuck on Okta MFA loop.
Zoe Park: hey @Noah welcome! when did you accept the Kandji profile? sometimes choosing setup later defers the MDM bootstrap until first user login. can you check System Settings > Privacy & Security > Profiles?
Noah Kim: i don't see any profiles listed. Kandji web UI shows device serial but status=deferred_profile. Okta just rejects device trust and says "device not enrolled".
Onboard Bot: Auto-scan: serial C02NEWUSER01 present but profile status=deferred. Suggested action: trigger remote profile push or instruct user to run enrollment from terminal. Ticket #ONB-9204 opened.
Zoe Park: easiest path: join corp-vpn (or ethernet), open Terminal and run:

```
sudo profiles renew -type enrollment
```
That forces the MDM to finish. If Terminal prompts for admin, we can push a temporary one-time admin via Kandji.
Noah Kim: i'm on the guest wifi from home. can't join corp-vpn. i can tether my phone to hotspot until i get to the office in a few hours. any workaround without VPN?
Devon Chen: for Okta device trust we need the cert that Kandji injects in the System keychain. If you can hotspot and allow the profiles command, it might work. Otherwise we can remote-push the profile via Kandji if the device checks in over internet (it should). Zoe, can you try a remote profile install?
Zoe Park: pushing remote enrollment now. keeping it low-risk: pushing only the MDM profile.
Onboard Bot: Remote job "install-mdm-profile" queued for C02NEWUSER01 by Zoe Park. Estimated 30s.
Onboard Bot: Remote job succeeded. MDM profile installed.
Noah Kim: i checked Profiles and now see the MDM one. re-logging into Okta works — device trust passed. thank you!
Devon Chen: great. quick postmortem note: choosing "set up later" can skip parts of automated flow on some macOS versions; we'll add a line to onboarding docs to keep network connected until first login or avoid deferring enrollment.
Noah Kim: will add a 1-liner in #docs-onboarding. appreciate the help! :smile:
